record.question: Which of the following is not a part of Article 20 of the Constitution of India?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
Article 20(1) bars conviction under a law made after the act and a heavier-than-applicable penalty; clause (2) bars being prosecuted and punished twice for the same offence; clause (3) protects an accused from being compelled to testify against themself. Those three protections map to the other listed choices. Article 20 does not list a standalone prohibition against torture, so that is the exception asked for.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/cb1b190ea633a1746368ed1fac35fb30.pdf
